name: DO NOT REDEEM!
summary:
Welcome to your new job. The headset is sticky, the boss is yelling, and the phones never stop ringing.

DO NOT REDEEM! is a VR comedy where you work the phones at a ridiculous fake call center. Pick a scam, answer the call, and use your real voice to talk each caller into it. There’s no script and no dialogue wheel. You just talk.

Every caller is a fully voiced AI character with their own personality. Grandmas, fake celebrities, conspiracy guys, crypto bros and Florida Men all listen to what you actually
